Lets an Agent drive the We"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Chat DevTools like a browser — page navigation, element interaction, state reading, network capture "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"& mocking. 面向 AI Agent 的微信小程序自动化 CLI 让 Agent 像操作浏览器一样操作微信开发者工具——页面导航、元素交互、状态读取、网"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"wxpilot"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A CLI for automating WeChat Mini Programs, built for AI Agents."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Lets an Agent drive the WeChat DevTools like a browser — page navigation, element interaction, state"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" reading, network capture & mocking."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Built for Agents**: All command output is compact by default and uniformly truncated to 4000 cha"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"racters, minimizing context consumption.
- **Ref mechanism**: After `view`, interactive elements are"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" auto-numbered `%N`; the Agent taps/types by number, with no need to maintain selectors.
- **Low-tok"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"en lookup**: `find <query>` locates elements by text/class/placeholder/tag and returns `%N` directly"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" — no need to read the whole page.
- **Auto project detection**: Omit the path and it auto-scans for"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" `dist/project.config.json` under the current directory; prompts interactively when multiple candida"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"tes exist.
- **Built-in proxy capture**: `--proxy` spins up an HTTP/HTTPS MITM proxy in one command,"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" supporting request mocking and body inspection.
- **JSON mode**: `--json` emits structured results "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"for easy parsing by programs/Agents.
- **Managed daemon**: The CLI auto-spawns a background daemon o"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"n first call, communicating over a Unix socket, and auto-exits after 30 min idle.
- **Recommended Ag"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ent integration**: Use the Skill + CLI workflow as the primary integration path; an optional MCP std"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"io adapter is available for MCP-based hosts."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The CLI and daemon are decoupled: the CLI only parses arguments and formats output, while the daemon"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" handles the actual automation, proxy, and state. - `wxp-daemon` → `~/.wxpilot/bin/wxp-daemon`"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"If `~/.local/bin` is not in PATH, append it as prompted:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Build from source"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"> `packages/web` is the website source, unrelated to the CLI — you can ignore it when building from "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ages/web` is the website source, unrelated to the CLI — you can ignore it when building from source."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Quick Start"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Core Concepts"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Ref mechanism"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"After running `wxpilot view` or `wxpilot find`, interactive elements on the page are assigned tempor"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ary numbers `%N` (starting from %1)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Numbers are regenerated on each `view` / `find`.
- After `goto` / `back` / `reload`, numbers are *"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"*invalidated** — re-run `view`.
- Using an expired ref errors with: `ref_expired: %N`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**Interactive node detection** (dual signal): the `outerWxml()` snapshot from DevTools does not pres"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"erve event attributes like `bindtap`, so two signals are used:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"1. `data-*` attributes — preserved in the snapshot, used as a proxy signal for bindtap (~80% coverag"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"e).
2. Source-file fingerprints — read the `.wxml` sources, extract `tag:sorted-classes` fingerprint"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"s of nodes that have bindtap, and recover nodes missed by the `data-*` heuristic."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Project path auto-detection"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The `projectPath` argument of `wxpilot start` is optional:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- When omitted, scans up to 2 levels of subdirectories under CWD for `dist` directories containing `"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"project.config.json`.
- Single candidate: used automatically.
- Multiple candidates: interactive sel"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ection.
- No candidate: error, prompting you to pass it manually."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Command Reference"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"### Connection management"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"### Navigation"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"### View"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"### Interaction"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"### Read"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"### Network proxy"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p51s1","text":"### Execution"},{"id":"p52s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p53s1","text":"### Daemon"},{"id":"p54s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p55s1","text":"### Global options"},{"id":"p56s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p57s1","text":"## Network Proxy & Mocking"},{"id":"p58s1","text":"For capture, prefer `wxpilot start <projectPath> --proxy [--https]`, which ensures the proxy is up w"},{"id":"p58s2","text":"ithin the same session."},{"id":"p59s1","text":"### HTTP mode"},{"id":"p60s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p61s1","text":"### HTTPS MITM mode (install the certificate the first time)"},{"id":"p62s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p63s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p64s1","text":"| Module | Responsibility |"},{"id":"p65s1","text":"| `wxp-cli` | Argument parsing, daemon detection/spawn, RPC calls, output formatting |
| `wxp-daemon"},{"id":"p65s2","text":"` | JSON-RPC server, runtime state, automator, proxy and storage |
| `wxp-rpc` + `wxp-common` | RPC "},{"id":"p65s3","text":"protocol and shared constants |
| `wxp-snapshot` + `wxp-ref-store` | WXML → element tree, interactio"},{"id":"p65s4","text":"n detection, %N ref storage |
| `wxp-proxy` + `wxp-store` | HTTP/HTTPS proxy, network log storage |"},{"id":"p66s1","text":"Default runtime files:"},{"id":"p67s1","text":"- `~/.wxpilot/rust-daemon.sock` — daemon communication socket
- `~/.wxpilot/rust-daemon.pid` — daemo"},{"id":"p67s2","text":"n PID lock (ensures a single instance)"}],"truncated":true}
